articles.title: Senators at Golden Knights projected lineups
After the Buzzer: Johansson makes his mark in Senators debut with first career point
Golden Knights to Host Noche de Los VGK on Tuesday
Chabot ‘slowly feeling better every day’ as he skates with main group for first time since injury

away.summary: The Senators (8-4-0) are on a five-game road trip that begins in Vegas. Jonas Johansson is projected to start in goal after making a strong Senators debut with a win over the Rangers, while Linus Ullmark remains out with a lower-body injury. Ottawa will dress the same lineup from Saturday's victory, with Thomas Chabot skating in practice but not expected to play Tuesday.

doubtful.detail: questionable after leaving morning skate with an apparent injury; being evaluated

home.summary: The Golden Knights (8-4-1) host the Senators for their Noche de Los VGK celebration. Adin Hill is projected to start, though Carter Hart is questionable after leaving morning skate with an apparent injury. Mitch Marner returns after missing two games for the birth of his second child, while Jonas Rondbjerg makes his season debut following a recall from Henderson.
